newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia likely to get credit rating in Nov.- expert.
newsitem.headline: Russia likely to get credit rating in Nov.- expert.

text.p: The rating agencies preparing ratings for Russia's first Eurobond are likely to issue them in November, the head of the finance ministry's Economic Expert Group said on Friday.
"It will be reasonable to expect them by November," Jochen Wermuth told a news conference.
First Deputy Finance Minister Andrei Vavilov said last week he expected the rating to be drawn up by October 10.
Three rating agencies visited Moscow in September and Wermuth said one of the agencies was from Europe and the other two from the United States.
Western bankers said one of the agencies was Standard & Poors.
Wermuth said it usually took two to three months to draw up a rating.
